text: こんな　ところで　ねちゃって　しょーが　ないわね！

structure.jp: しょーが　ないわね！

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちゃう is a casual squashed form of てしまう, which says something happened completely, often to your annoyance. ねちゃって = 'went and fell asleep'.

patterns.name: 〜しょうがない
patterns.explanation: しょーがない is a casual way to say しょうがない, meaning there is nothing to be done. Here it means the person is hopeless. しょーが　ないわね = 'he's hopeless, isn't he'.
